title: Custom cakes ready by 6am in Riverstone — no eggs, no compromise
summary:
Most bakeries near Vineyard and Box Hill don't open before 8am. Riverstone does — 6am on weekdays. That's deliberate: for the parent collecting a birthday cake before the school run, or the early shift worker picking up a custom eggless cake before their shift starts.

Every cake is 100% eggless. Six sizes, 15 flavours, buttercream, fondant or ganache. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. Free parking at the shopping centre.
